description: Source code for a Bluetooth periodic advertising demo using Zephyr RTOS, including setup of advertising parameters, response handling, connection management, and main execution loop.

methods.name: request_cb
methods.description: Callback to set subevent data for periodic advertising.

methods.name: get_address
methods.description: Extracts Bluetooth device address from advertisement data.

methods.name: response_cb
methods.description: Handles responses from advertising subevents and initiates connections.

methods.name: init_bufs
methods.description: Initializes dummy data buffers for advertising.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to initialize Bluetooth, set up advertising, and run the event loop.
